**Key Theme:** Crime / History  

---

### Father who killed Oregon school gunman describes anguish over children he couldn't save

**Summary:** Kaylub Giamanco, who intervened and killed a teenage gunman during a deadly Oregon school shooting, has spoken publicly about his grief over the victims he could not save. While local community members have praised him as a hero, Giamanco expressed deep emotional distress in the aftermath of the event.  
**Key Theme:** Public Safety / Tragedy

**Source:** New York Post  
**Summary:** Michael Sweeney, a 14-year-old high school student in New York, was denied early high school graduation due to age-related administrative restrictions. Despite already taking full-time classes at a community college, local regulations prevent him from receiving his diploma early.
